responsibility: Implements a late RTL optimization pass that folds constant address adjustments out of register add/move chains and into the displacement fields of load/store MEM references. Working basic-block by basic-block with DF UD/DU chains, it analyzes which instructions can safely propagate offsets, computes affected memory roots and accumulated displacements, checks target recognizability/validity of the rewritten memory operands, then commits the new MEM offsets and deletes or simplifies now-redundant add-immediate instructions, finally registering the pass as fold_mem_offsets in the RTL pipeline.
